reader.requirement: At 85 the operand of a relative-file REWRITE must be a record-name of a level-01 record described under an FD in the File Section (qualified by its file-name or a containing name where needed); a Working-Storage or Linkage item, a subordinate item, a reference-modified record, a file-name, an SD record or an unqualified ambiguous name must be refused, and a qualified record-name must rewrite the file it belongs to.

edition-consulted.switches: REWRITE FILE file-name-1 (the 2002 alternative to record-name-1) refused below 2002 (COBOL0900)

reader.edition-search: The record-name identity check itself (ResolveRecordName, FileWhoseRecordIs) consults no edition: grep of Edition.Year/CobolVersion/ConstructRegistry in StatementValidation.cs and SequentialIoBinder.cs finds no site on this path; the only edition switches are the two parse-arm gates on phrases 1985 lacks.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the record-name rule is the same code at every edition; only the FILE alternative and the lock phrase (2002 forms) are refused at 85.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb347_record_name_identity exercises the qualified record-name on a sequential/sort file, not a relative REWRITE; not exercised: relative REWRITE with a qualified duplicate record-name, a second 01 record, a variable-length record, and the refusal forms.

reader.notes: ResolveRewriteRecord resolves the (possibly qualified) operand and ResolveRecordName accepts it only when it is identically one of FileModel.Records of a declared or visible FD, before the relative arm (KeyedIoBinder.BindRewrite) is chosen. Diagnostics cite the 2023 clause text, which is the same sentence as the 1985 rule.

refuter.evidence: Probes at --std 85: Q2R66 (REWRITE of a level-66 RENAMES of the FD record) -> COBOL1757 'subordinate to REC ... name that record'; Q2C88 (REWRITE of an 88 under the record) -> COBOL1639 condition-name identifies no data item; Q2CD (REWRITE of a Communication Section CD record, a 1985-only section) -> COBOL1757 'not a logical record of any file description entry'; Q2RPT (REWRITE of a Report Section 01 group name) -> COBOL5092, refused; Q2GLOB (contained program REWRITEs 'REC OF FA' and unqualified REC of a GLOBAL relative FD) -> RW 00 / IK9 23 / R2 XXXYYY 00 in the container: the record-name of a global file rewrites its own file. The 1985 text (corrigenda C135/C274 touch SR1 only) leaves SR2 as printed. cite.py: OK  §1985:VIII.4.6.3 SR2  (4.6.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR2.
